AboutMe.Title: About me
AboutMe.Paragraphs: With 5+ years of hands-on experience in backend engineering, I specialize in building scalable, cloud-native systems using Java, Spring Boot, Quarkus, PostgreSQL, and MongoDB. I enjoy solving complex engineering problems, improving system performance, and designing architectures that scale.
I’ve worked across life sciences, data engineering, and product development—leading teams, conducting client workshops, and translating business needs into robust technical solutions.
My expertise spans microservices, CI/CD automation, cloud deployments, and integrating modern data platforms like Databricks and Azure Data Factory.
